# sqlite-vec-go-bindings licenses

github.com/asg017/sqlite-vec-go-bindings v0.1.6, which Blitz links (the
sqlite-vec extension for SQLite databases, spec_databases_046), carries no
license file in its module: the repository added LICENSE-MIT and
LICENSE-APACHE on 2026-03-26, after its last tag, declaring the same
dual license as sqlite-vec itself (MIT or Apache-2.0). These are those
files, copied from the repository, for THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES
(tools/notices reads third_party/licenses/<module> when a module has none).
Drop them once a release of the bindings ships its license files.
